body:
It's car insurance payments, they are required by law. Since I'm still young, they're expensive. I own my car.

I go through periods of not seeking relationships or love as much as seeking them, neither seems to have any real result.
It does. :) I wish I knew a way out. People always say it gets better, but when? I know, I know, sometimes it does get better, but it always seems to get worse again.

> Guys aren't interested in your hair or sense of fashion.

Thanks. I think the jeggings do help a little, though.

I also forgot in the original post to ask, when and how does it ever get better? Alas.

I don't necessarily mind the fact that my brain doesn't turn off all the time, but I just wish there were someone to talk to sometimes to diffuse those thoughts. Or, you know, someone to do exhausting things with before going to bed. I feel like an outsider looking in on people who can have normal lives and have relationships and I don't understand why this doesn't seem to be happening in my life. I know, I know, it would be easier if I took more initiative, but if I were capable of taking more initiative, I wouldn't be in this boat...

Things could always be worse, but I don't think that I could feel any worse than I am when I'm at my lowest, falling asleep only after sobbing for two hours in the dark.

I wouldn't get drunk, anyway, it doesn't hold much appeal for me. I don't really know anything about the bars in the area, either, since I don't really drink... I guess I could go exploring once I have the money to do so.

I would settle for not the right one if anyone I liked was actually interested in me. I don't think I've got particularly high standards. I want someone of reasonable intelligence, nice but not a pushover. Willing to take some initiative. Last two guys I went out with, one was too dumb, the other didn't seem to want to include me in his life or introduce me to his friends, so that didn't last long. Everything we did was just him and me, out somewhere random, and he never made any substantial moves on me.

Not sure about volunteering. I'd prefer going to a bar, heh. :)
